correctness.rationale: The code is reconstructed from the exact source polynomial, Gold exponent, trace-zero conditions, and coefficients \(a_1=\alpha,a_2=\alpha^2\). The resulting defining set has \(51\) elements, the generator has rank \(8\), and the \(256\)-word census exactly reproduces the published enumerator. Every positive-dimensional subspace of the message space is then generated exactly once in RREF; the dimension totals match the Gaussian binomial coefficients. For each basis, the union of basis-word supports equals the support of the entire subcode, so the exhaustive \(417198\)-subspace census proves the complete spectra and the hierarchy without sampling.

value.rationale: Example 1 is the smallest explicit four-weight member used by the source to demonstrate its new Gold-type self-orthogonal minimal construction. Generalized Hamming weights are the standard higher-dimensional refinement of minimum distance, while the complete subcode-support distribution records substantially finer incidence information than the ordinary enumerator. The exact hierarchy and all 417198 subcode supports therefore provide a natural complete higher-support fingerprint for a highlighted new code, including nontrivial minimum multiplicities in every dimension, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
